data.title: Yongzhe Donghua Xilie 2
data.synopsis:
In a fantasy world where humans and demons are long-time enemies, humans choose "Braves" as symbols of justice, while "Demons" are branded as evil.
But when the ancient demon god awakens, the war begins to blur the lines between right and wrong. Power, oppression, and prejudice begin to unravel, forcing every character to question:
What is justice? Who decides what is evil?
This isn't just a fantasy adventure—
It's a battle of beliefs, freedom, and breaking the labels that define us.

(Source: YouTube)

titles.title: Di Ling Ai: Mo Shui Linglong

data.title: Di Ling Ai: Mo Shui Linglong
data.synopsis:
All things possess a spirit, and the power of nature coalesced into various conscious fairies. However, due to humanity's neglect of nature and the awakening of suppressed powers, the fairies have been harmed. A human girl encounters a fairy from the depths of the water and they have known each other for many years. However, they cannot overcome the barrier between celestial and mortal. On a wondrous journey, the girl resolves to find her own power. She believes that humanity is also part of nature, and that there must be a way for humans and nature to coexist harmoniously. Can she protect nature?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.synopsis:
Sikong Zhen discovers the mechanical beasts in the underground city and studies them privately. Wu Zetian notices something amiss and sends Shangguan Wan'er to investigate secretly, while the Yaotian organization also has its own plans… Several forces intertwine, creating a turbulent undercurrent. Faced with the eventual outbreak of a common crisis, everyone, for the safety of Chang'an, overcomes all difficulties and works together to defeat the mechanical monsters, restoring peace to Chang'an.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
